A_ml_target_leakage_fix.description: _build_ml_vector() was feeding cutting_time_estimate_s as a feature to the ML model. This is a textbook case of target leakage — the model would learn to copy the time value directly instead of learning to predict it from geometry features.
A_ml_target_leakage_fix.now: cutting_time_estimate_s REMOVED from feature vector. Added: panel_fits_stock (bool), v_slot_single_pass_length_mm. panel_yield_percent is -1.0 for oversized panels (was 0 — indistinguishable from 0% valid yield).
A_ml_target_leakage_fix.impact_ml_pipeline: BREAKING: ML models trained on V2.1 CSV will fail on V2.2 (different column count, different semantics). Retrain required.

B_panel_yield_fix.description: Panels larger than stock plate (2900x1220) had yield capped at 100% via min(...,100), and waste_mm went negative (e.g. [-3756, -1551]). No 90-degree rotation was checked.
B_panel_yield_fix.logic: Tests both orientations (0deg and 90deg). If panel fits rotated: panel_rotated=true in output. If panel doesn't fit at all: yield_percent=null, waste_mm=null, panel_fits_stock=false.
B_panel_yield_fix.narrative_update: VAROVANI: Panel XxY mm se nevejde na surovou desku... (when oversized), (panel otocen o 90deg) notation when rotated.

C_missing_csv_columns_fix.description: When semantic_zone_count=0, columns zone_lengths_mean, largest_zone_entity_count, max_zone_spacing_mm were never emitted → CSV schema inconsistency across files. Also _simple_zone_split() never computed spacing_mean_mm.
C_missing_csv_columns_fix.fix_1: _build_ml_vector(): zone features always emitted with default=0 (not conditional on zone_count>0)
C_missing_csv_columns_fix.fix_2: _simple_zone_split(): added spacing calculation from entity centers — max_zone_spacing_mm now reflects actual zone distances

D_layer_card.description: New CAM-import-ready layer analysis. Entities are aggregated by DXF color_index (ACI 0-255), cross-referenced with dxf_tool_config.json aci_color_mapping to determine cutter_type, base_speed, direction, and validation_status for each color.

new_functions.name: build_layer_card(entities, tool_config=None)
new_functions.description: Aggregates entities by color_index. Per color: entity_count, total_length_mm, point_count, point_density_per_meter, closed_count, open_count, closed_ratio, total_tac_rad, tac_per_meter, min_length_mm, max_length_mm, geometry_types[], layers[]. Tool config cross-reference: cutter_type, base_speed_mms, direction, validation_status, is_mapped. Output: dict with color_count, total_entities_mapped, total_entities_unmapped, colors[].

new_functions.name: write_layer_card_csv(data, out)
new_functions.description: Writes standalone {name}_layer_card.csv with 20 columns: color_index, color_name, entity_count, total_length_mm, point_count, closed_count, open_count, closed_ratio, total_tac_rad, tac_per_meter, point_density_per_meter, min_length_mm, max_length_mm, geometry_types, layers, cutter_type, base_speed_mms, direction, validation_status, is_mapped.

D_layer_card.json_output: New root key 'layer_card' in index JSON
D_layer_card.md_output: New section '## Layer Card (CAM Import Reference)' in Markdown output
D_layer_card.streamlit: New panel in Layers tab showing per-color table with tool assignment and validation status
D_layer_card.tool_config_passthrough: index_dxf() now accepts tool_config=None parameter and passes it to build_layer_card(). Previously build_layer_card() was called without tool_config, making all colors 'unmapped'.

known_issues_critical.title: Empty nesting_tree
known_issues_critical.description: nesting_tree is always empty, even when containment relationships exist. This regression from V2.1 means no hierarchical entity grouping is provided in the output.

known_issues_critical.title: Proximity matrix all zeros
known_issues_critical.description: proximity_matrix contains zeros for most shape group pairs. In some outputs the entire matrix is zero, making spatial relationship features useless for ML.

known_issues_critical.title: Tool assignment conflict
known_issues_critical.description: Entities assigned to both vibrate_cutter_0deg (based on ACI color from tool_config) and v_slot_45deg (based on geometry heuristic: open paths). Layer card correctly maps color to tool, but semantic analysis also heuristically assigns tools, creating ambiguity.

known_issues_critical.title: Tool_summary missing correct total_length
known_issues_critical.description: For V-slot, total_length_mm = 0 but single_pass_length_mm and double_pass_length_mm are correct. Discrepancy makes the summary unreliable.

known_issues_critical.title: Wrong graph_connected_components count
known_issues_critical.description: Some panels report graph_connected_components=9 but all entities belong to one spatial cluster. Components are counted from adjacency/containment only, not from intersection/touch.

known_issues_critical.title: Duplicated zones
known_issues_critical.description: Same entity_ids appear in multiple zones (identical zone content with different zone indices). Each entity should belong to exactly one zone.

known_issues_minor.title: Regularity_score negative values
known_issues_minor.description: Negative values (e.g. -4.477) when zone pattern is non-uniform. Score is unbounded, which is confusing.

known_issues_minor.title: min_feature_width_mm always zero
known_issues_minor.fix: Implement via distance transform or minimum entity distance from proximity matrix

known_issues_minor.title: Inconsistent bbox field naming
known_issues_minor.description: global_bbox_mm uses absolute coordinates, panel_bbox_mm uses relative dimensions. Same name 'bbox_mm' with different semantics is confusing.
known_issues_minor.fix: Rename panel_bbox_mm to panel_size_mm or relative_bbox_mm

v23_plan.architecture_decision: Fully standalone functions with own inputs/outputs (NOT pipeline pattern, NOT minimal refactoring). Each module is independently callable.

priority_1_fixes.task: Fix C3 — Tool assignment conflict resolution
priority_1_fixes.approach: Define clear priority: if ACI color is mapped in layer_card tool_config, that overrides geometry heuristic. Otherwise fallback to geometry detection. Add 'tool_conflict_detected' boolean flag when both rules apply to same entity.
Recursively build nesting_tree from containment edges (parent → children). Include all entities. Use shapely contains() for polygon-in-polygon relationships.
priority_1_fixes.outputs: JSON nesting_tree array with parent_ids and child_ids

priority_1_fixes.approach: Compute minimum Euclidean distance between entity bounding boxes or convex hulls. Use STRtree spatial index for efficiency on large entity counts.
priority_1_fixes.outputs: Accurate proximity_matrix in JSON and as ML features

priority_2_enhancements.task: Modular architecture — separate functions with own outputs
priority_2_enhancements.approach: Split index_dxf() into independently callable modules: geometry_extraction(dxf) → entities, spatial_analysis(entities) → proximity/containment/graph, semantic_analysis(entities, tool_config) → zones/cutting_time, feature_extraction(entities, zones) → ML vector, output_formatting(data) → JSON/MD/CSV. Each returns self-contained dict.
priority_2_enhancements.files: New: dxf_geometry_extractor.py, dxf_spatial_analyzer.py, dxf_semantic_analyzer.py, dxf_feature_extractor.py, dxf_output_formatter.py OR all in dxf_geometry_indexer_v2.py with clear section headers

features: point_density_per_meter — total entity vertices / panel perimeter
cut_density_m_per_m2 — total entity length / panel area

priority_2_enhancements.approach: Define FIXED_CSV_SCHEMA tuple in write_ml_vectors_csv(). Always write all columns in fixed order regardless of data. Missing values → null/0.

priority_2_enhancements.note: These are legitimate features (time components based on geometry and tool selection, NOT the target variable)
